newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy petroleum product use rises 3.5 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Italy petroleum product use rises 3.5 pct in April.

text.p: Italian consumption of petroleum products, after posting a fall for eight consecutive months, rose 3.5 percent in April year-on-year to 7.6 million tonnes, according to data from trade group Unione Petrolifera (UP).
But UP said in a statement that in January-April 1997 total consumption was down 5.5 percent on the same period last year to 30.74 million tonnes.
The April rise affected nearly all products apart from fuel oil for use by the power generating sector which saw a 1.4 percent fall to 1.73 million tonnes.
In the first four months, fuel oil consumption by this sector fell 14.3 percent to 6.95 million tonnes.
In April, demand for gasoline and diesel for the auto sector rose respectively by 0.9 percent to 1.54 million tonnes and by 0.7 percent to 1.29 million tonnes.
April sales of lead-free gasoline, at 748,000 tonnes, represented some 49.2 percent of total petrol consumption, UP said. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
